title: Tyler's conversion at the Vatican archives
summary: Diana Pasulka tells of Tyler's conversion at the Vatican archives, about unspecified (2010s) at Vatican City, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: yeah that was really an amazing um experience for me to witness the conversion that he went through uh we started at the Vatican looking at the the records of uh Joseph of copertino and a and bilocating sister um Maria agaga

plain: A religious studies professor, Diana Pasulka, says that in the 2010s she watched a man she calls Tyler go through a deep personal conversion. According to her, it began at the Vatican, where they read old church records about Joseph of Copertino, a saint said to float in the air, and Maria de Agreda, a nun said to appear in two places at once. She tells it as a striking thing to witness, one that ties modern UFO interest to old religious marvels.
